an5.139:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo na rājāraho hoti na rājabhoggo. na rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.139:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ, akkhamo saddānaṃ, akkhamo gandhānaṃ, akkhamo rasānaṃ, akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ?
an5.139:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthikāyaṃ vā disvā assakāyaṃ vā disvā rathakāyaṃ vā disvā pattikāyaṃ vā disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ.
an5.139:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ?
an5.139:3.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthisaddaṃ vā sutvā, assasaddaṃ vā sutvā rathasaddaṃ vā sutvā pattisaddaṃ vā sutvā bheripaṇava saṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddaṃ vā sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ.
an5.139:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ?
an5.139:4.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ye te rañño nāgā abhijātā saṅgāmāvacarā, tesaṃ muttakarīsassa gandhaṃ ghāyitvā saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ.
an5.139:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ?
an5.139:5.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ekissā vā tiṇodakadattiyā vimānito, dvīhi vā tīhi vā catuhi vā pañcahi vā tiṇodakadattī hi vimānito saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ.
an5.139:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ?
an5.139:6.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ekena vā saravedhena viddho, dvīhi vā tīhi vā catuhi vā pañcahi vā saravedhehi viddho saṃsīdati, visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:7.1: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo na rājāraho hoti na rājabhoggo. na rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.139:8.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu na āhuneyyo hoti, na pāhuneyyo, na dakkhiṇeyyo, na añjalikaraṇīyo, na anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an5.139:8.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ, akkhamo saddānaṃ, akkhamo gandhānaṃ, akkhamo rasānaṃ, akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:9.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ?
an5.139:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rajanīye rūpe sārajjati. na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ
an5.139:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ.
an5.139:10.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ?
an5.139:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā rajanīye sadde sārajjati. na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ
an5.139:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ.
an5.139:11.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ?
an5.139:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā rajanīye gandhe sārajjati. na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ
an5.139:11.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ.
an5.139:12.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ?
an5.139:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā rajanīye rase sārajjati. na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ
an5.139:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ.
an5.139:13.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ?
an5.139:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā rajanīye phoṭṭhabbe sārajjati. na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ
an5.139:13.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:14.1: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na āhuneyyo hoti, na pāhuneyyo, na dakkhiṇeyyo, na añjalikaraṇīyo, na anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an5.139:15.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.139:15.3: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo khamo hoti rūpānaṃ. khamo hoti saddānaṃ. khamo hoti gandhānaṃ. khamo hoti rasānaṃ. khamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:16.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo khamo hoti rūpānaṃ?
an5.139:16.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthikāyaṃ vā disvā assakāyaṃ vā disvā rathakāyaṃ vā disvā pattikāyaṃ vā disvā na saṃsīdati, na visīdati, santhambhati, sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:16.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khamo hoti rūpānaṃ.

an5.139:18.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khamo hoti gandhānaṃ.

an5.139:20.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo khamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ?
an5.139:20.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato ekena vā saravedhena viddho, dvīhi vā tīhi vā catuhi vā pañcahi vā saravedhehi viddho na saṃsīdati, na visīdati, santhambhati, sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:20.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
